item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 3 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 3 #SLPRSD
Issued at 03:55 PM 25 October 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #OrientalMindoro(Bansud, Bongabong), #Romblon(Magdiwang, Cajidiocan, SanFernando, Ferrol, Odiongan, SantaMaria, SanAgustin, SanAndres, Calatrava), #Sorsogon(CityOfSorsogon, Magallanes, Bulan, Castilla, Pilar, Donsol), #Albay(Jovellar and Daraga) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Albay(Guinobatan, Camalig), #CamarinesSur(Caramoan, Presentacion), #Catanduanes(Caramoran, SanAndres), #Romblon(SanJose, SantaFe, Looc, Alcantara, Romblon, Corcuera) and #Masbate(Monreal) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
